```{r}
library(sf)
library(tidycensus)
library(tidyverse)
```




```{r}
test_data <- tibble(
  coloumn_A = c(100, 200, 300, 400), 
  coloumn_B = c(200, 300, 400, 500),
  geoid = c(1,2,3,4)
)

test_data


another_test_data <- tibble(
  coloumn_X = c(5, 10, 15, 100, 150, 200, 300, 400), 
  coloumn_Y = c(20, 40, 60, 80, 100, 150, 200, 300),
  geoid = c(1, 2, 3,4,5, 6, 7, 8)
)

another_test_data
```
```{r}
left_join(test_data, another_test_data, by="geoid")
right_join(test_data, another_test_data, by="geoid")
inner_join(test_data, another_test_data, by="geoid")
anti_join(test_data, another_test_data, by="geoid")
full_join(test_data, another_test_data, by="geoid")
semi_join(test_data, another_test_data, by="geoid")
```

```{r}
philly_data <- get_acs(
  geography = "tract",
  year = 2023,
  county = "Philadelphia",
  variables = c(
    med_inc = "B19013_001",
    total_pop = "B01003_001"
  ),
  geometry = TRUE,
  survey = "acs5",
  output = "wide",
  state = "PA"
)

names(philly_data)
glimpse(philly_data)
```

```{r}
philly_data$med_inc_se <- if_else(!is.na(philly_data$med_incM) & philly_data$med_incM > 0,philly_data$med_incM/1.645, NA_real_)
philly_data$med_inc_cv <- if_else(!is.na(philly_data$med_incE) & philly_data$med_incE > 0, philly_data$med_inc_se/philly_data$med_incE * 100, NA_real_)
philly_data$reliability <- case_when(is.na(med_inc_cv) ~ "Unavailable", med_inc_cv < 12 ~ "High", med_inc_cv <= 40 ~ "Moderate", TRUE ~ "Low"  )
```

```{r}
philly_data %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% count(philly_data$reliability)
```
```{r}
philly_data %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% summarise(
  tract_count = n(),
  mean_income = mean(philly_data$med_incE, na.rm = TRUE),
  mean_cv = mean(philly_data$med_inc_cv, na.rm = TRUE)
)
```
